host.description: Hostname or IP address the ECFlow server binds to for client connections.

port.description: TCP port number used by the ECFlow server for client communication.

auth_mode.description: Authentication method for clients. Use 'password' for username/password or 'none' for no auth.

data_dir.description: Directory where the server stores persistent state (suites, logs, recovery data).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for graceful shutdown before terminating the process.

recovery.description: If true, attempt to recover aborted suites from persisted state on startup.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the web UI and secure client connections.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client hostnames/IPs. Empty list allows all hosts.

auto_load_suites.description: List of suite paths to load automatically at startup.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors.
